title: FiltersPanel: add BevelFilter and GradientBevelFilter UI panels
description: FiltersPanel.tsx supports DropShadow, Glow, Blur, GradientGlow but is missing BevelFilter and GradientBevelFilter — 2 of Flash 8's 7 filter types. Implement UI panels for both: BevelFilter (distance, angle, color, highlight color, blur X/Y, strength, quality, type=inner/outer/full, knockout, onTop); GradientBevelFilter (same params but with gradient colors/alphas/ratios arrays). The filter types are already defined in packages/core/src/engine/types.ts and the SWF encoder already handles them. This task is purely a UI gap.
